༄༅/ /rgyun khyer gyi rim pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa dngos grub bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgyun khyer gyi rim pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa dngos grub bdud rtsi'i gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

rang nyid tha mal spyi bo ru// hūm̐ dkar las byung pad zla'i steng*// rdor sems dkar po phyag gnyis kyi// g.yas pas rdo rje g.yon dril bsnams// skyil krung longs spyod rdzogs sku'i chas// snang la rang bzhin med par gyur// spyi mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros ye shes sems// spyan drangs dbyer med gcig 'dres gyur// thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ dkar mthar// yi ge brgya pa g.yas bskor gsal// oṃ badz+ra satwa sogs brjod/ phyi nang sku gsung thugs la sogs// rtsa ba yan lag dam 'gal rnams// gnong 'gyod drag pos bzod par gsol// sku yi cha las bdud rtsi babs// sgrib gnyis bag chags dud khu ltar// nag nyil phyir thon lha 'od zhu// rang dang dbyer med chu bzhag ltar// bde gsal mi rtog ngang la bzhag /dge ba 'di yis sogs/ karma mngon dga'i ngor spel/// / ༈ hrīḥ gzung 'dzin chos rnams stong pa'i ngang nyid las// rang nyid tha mal spyi bor pad zla'i steng*// hrīḥdakar 'od kyi 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas// yongs gyur rigs 'dus khyab bdag he ru ka /badz+ra sa twa dung dang kun+da'i mdog /gsal zhing 'tsher la 'od dang 'od zer 'bar// dbu la rigs lnga'i prog zhu dar dpyangs brgyan// 'gying bag tshul gyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// lha rdzas dar gyi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs bklubs// rin chen snyan cha mgul rgyan la sogs pa// longs sku'i chas rdzogs zhabs gnyis sems skyil bzhugs// gzhan yang rtsa gsum lha tshogs sprin ltar gtibs// gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs kyi hūm̐ 'od kyis// bskul bas sangs rgyas byang sems spyan drangs thim// rgyal ba rab 'byams dkyil 'khor kun 'dus pa'i// bdag nyid chen por mngon sum lham mer gsal// bder gshegs 'dus pa bla ma he ru ka /chos kun 'byung gnas gsang sngags ston pa che// tshogs mchog rang bzhin dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// gsol 'debs skal ldan rgyud byin brlab du gsol//

ces pa'i gsol 'debs lan kha shas dang*/ bla ma'i thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ mthar sngags// yig brgyas bskor ba de las 'od 'phros pas// 'phags mchod 'gro ba'i sgrib sbyong khyad par du// sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bdag lus gang*// thog med nas bsags sdig sgrib byang zhing dag /rnam smin lus sbyong dri med shel ltar gyur// de nas yig brgya ci nus bzlas shing*/ yig drug kyang bzla'o// de nas spro na brjod med don bshags bton la rgyal gsung tshad ma nyid de lhag par phan yon che zhing*/ bsdus par na/ kyai ho rgyal kun 'dus pa dgongs// bdag cag ma rig nongs pa yis// so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi// dam tshig nyes ltung 'gal 'khrul rnams// mi 'chab mi sbed mthol zhing bshags// phyin chad sdom la gnas par bgyi// mgon po'i gsung las bu khyod kyi// sdig sgrib dag ces dbugs dbyung gyur// rjes rim ni/ lha sku 'od zhu rang thim gnyis med ngang*// spros bral bde ba chen po'i klong du bzhag / mthar dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo ba spyi ltar bya'o// ces pa'ang karma chags med dngos sprul karma bstan 'dzin phrin las bka'i bskul ltar si tus spel/// / ༈ 'jam dpal dmar ser shes rab blo 'phel bzhugs/ na maḥsarba dz+nya dharmā kā ra ya/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal dpa' bo dmar ser gyi sgo nas shes rab blo 'phel sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag rnams la phan bde'i dpyid du 'di ltar spel bar bya ste/ bslu med skyabs gnas mchog gsum la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// bdag gis shes rab bslab pa yis// kun kyang thams cad mkhyen thob shog /oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ chos rnams dmigs med stong chen ngang*// sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab rgyas dbus// a las bsil zer byed pa yi// dkyil 'khor dri med nya gang steng*// rang rig ngo bo dhīḥdamar ser// 'od 'phros rgyal kun mchod pas mnyes// 'gro ba'i sgrib tshogs mun pa bsal// slar yang 'od zer 'dus pa las// rang nyid rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs// nyin byed 'char ka'i mdangs zer las// ches cher lhag pa'i kha dog 'chang*// ral ba'i cod pan spyi gtsug tu// bcing zhing zur phud g.yon ngos 'phyangs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi 'dzum brjid// phyag g.yas shes rab ral gri mchog

/mi shes drwa ba gcod par byed// g.yon pas ut+pal sngon po ni// 'dab rgyas steng du pusti kaḥ /rab tu sgeg ba'i nyams dang ldan// zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung*// rin chen sna tshogs lha rdzas kyi// rgyan dang na bza' mdzes par bklubs// brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i cha gang zhing*// ri bong 'dzin pa'i rgyab yol can// dbang gzhu lta bu'i 'od 'od zer// rab tu 'phro ba'i dbus nyid du// snang la rang bzhin med pa yi// gsal stong lhun gyis grub par gsal// gnas gsum 'bru gsum sa bon mtshan// de las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi// gnas nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i// ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis med bstim// slar yang thugs las 'od 'phros pas// rigs lnga yab yum spyan drangs nas// mchod cing phyag 'tshal dbang bskur gsol// bdud rtsis lus gang chu lhag ma// yar brten mi bskyod rgyas gdab gyur// rang nyid lhar gsal snying gar ni// pad zla'i steng du yi ge dhīḥ /de mthar yig bdun g.yas su bskor// de las 'od 'phros rang gzhan gyi// rmongs pa'i gti mug bag nyal bcom// shes rab blo gros snang byed kyi// yon tan 'od stong phun sum tshogs// 'jig rten ma lus gsal bar gyur// oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ ci nus su bzlas la mthar/ oṃ ār+ya mañdzu shrī ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da bar brjod cing mchod la/ rgyal ba'i thugs rje mi mngon klong yangs nas// rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i nyi ma 'bum brdal zhing*// rgyal la mos ldan yid kyi dga' tshal du// rgyal ba'i go 'phang snang byed bstan du gsol// rgyal mchog ji bzhin blo gros thogs med kyis// rgyal ba ma lus mchod pa'i 'dab stong rgyas// rgyal bstan 'gro ba'i phun tshogs rgyan gyur nas// rgyal bas rjes su 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs// bcom ldan mgon po shes rab gnyen// 'jam dpal dpa' bo sgrub pa'i mthus// bdag blo'i mun pa kun bsal nas*// thams cad mkhyen nyid thob par shog

/dge ba 'di yis sogs dang*/ bsngo smon dkyus ltar bya'o// de ltar 'tsho byed pa gu ru tshe dbang gis bstsal ba'i ngor/ si tu pad+ma nyin mor byed pas rgyal zla'i dga' ba dang po la spel ba sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ chos kun stong pa'i ngang nyid las// pad dkar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥ// yongs gyur rang nyid spyan ras gzigs// dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa// dang po thal sbyar g.yas 'og gi// shel phreng g.yon 'og pad+ma dkar// dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras// longs spyod rdzogs sku zhabs rdor skyil// gnas gsum 'bru gsum yi ges mtshan// 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs nas// dam tshig pa la gnyis med thim// dbang lhas dbang bskur chu lhag ma// yar lud snang mthas rgyas btab gyur// thugs kar hrīḥmathar sngags phreng las// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod rigs drug gi// sdug bsngal rgyu bcas dag par bsgom// oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ci nus bzlas mthar/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ snod bcud lha yi dkyil 'khor pa// 'od zhu rang la thim par gyur// dar cig mnyam par bzhag /slar yang rang nyid spyan ras gzigs// yongs gyur snang grag rtog pa'i chos// kun kyang rgyal ba'i zhing du mos// dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo bar bya/ ces dbu mdzad tshul ldan ngor spel/// / ༈ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs mchi zhing*// 'gro ba'i don du sems bskyed do// swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las pad dkar zla ba'i steng*// rang sems hrīḥyig yongs gyur las// spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog dkar// zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang po gnyis// thal sbyar g.yas 'og shel phreng dang*// g.yon 'og pad+ma rin chen gyi// dbu rgyan snyan cha mgul rgyan dang*// phyag gdub zhabs gdub se mo do// ri dwags pags pas nu g.yon bkab// lha rdzas dar gyi stod g.yogs dang*// smad g.yogs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas// zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od 'phros pas// ye shes spyan drangs dbang bskur zhing*// 'od dpag med kyis rgyas gdab gyur// ar+ghaṃ

sogs kyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi snying gar zla steng hrīḥ /mtha' mar yig drug g.yas su 'khor// 'od 'phros rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bsdus// 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib kun sbyang gyur// yig drug ci nus bzlas la/ thun mtshams su gtor 'bul spro na/ a mṛta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bhūm̐ las rin chen snod du oṃ 'od zhu// gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zag med gyur// rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis 'jig rten mgon// spyan drangs mchod 'bul bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod// a kā ro tshar gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ rang nyid lhar gsal 'od zhu nas// thugs ka'i hrīḥyig la thim gyur// de yi ngang la mnyam par bzhag /slar yang skad cig dran rdzogs su// spyan ras gzigs dbang gsal ba'i ngang*// khyer so gsum ldan spyod pa bskyang*// mthar bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab bya'o// yo chung ma'i ngor spel/// / ༈ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi sgom bzlas nyung 'dus su bkod pa bzhugs so// swasti/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don bya bar 'dod na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs dang tshad med bzhi bcas sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā wa sogs/ snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun// gzung 'dzin bral ba'i stong bar gyur// de yi ngang las rang rtsal mdangs// rma byas btegs pa'i rin chen khrir// sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i steng*// rang sems hrīḥyig 'od 'phro 'dus// don gnyis byas te yongs gyur las// bcom ldan 'od mi 'gyur ba'i sku// pad+ma rā ga'i ri bo ltar// dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag mnyam bzhag /lhung bzed bdud rtsis bkang ba 'dzin// chos gos rnam gsum zhabs rdor skyil// mtshan dpe'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gsal// g.yas g.yon pad+ma zla ba'i steng*// phyag na pad+ma rdo rje 'dzin// rgyal sras thu bo mchog brgyad dang*// gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang chub sems// nyan thos rang rgyal tshogs kyis bskor// gtso bo'i gnas gsum oṃ ā hūm̐// thugs kar pad zlar hrīḥyig las// 'od 'phros bde chen zhing khams nas// bsgom pa dang 'dra'i ye shes pa// spyan drangs dam ye gnyis med gyur// slar yang 'od 'phros dbang lha bskul// dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag

/tshe dpag med kyis rgyas gdab cing*// thugs las spros pa'i lha mos mchod// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ thugs ka'i hrī mthar sngags kyi phreng*// g.yas bskor 'od kyis rgyal rnams mchod// kun kyang snang mtha'i skur gyur nas// rang thim slar yang 'od zer 'phros// rigs drug sems can sdig sgrib sbyong*// snod bcud lha yi rang bzhin gsal// sgra grags sngags la dran rtog thugs// dag pa rnam pa gsum ldan gyur// oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ ci nus bzla zhing*/ dmigs bsal tshe sgrub skabs/ slar yang lnga ldan 'od klong nas// sprul pa'i lha mo mgyogs ma'i tshogs// 'phros pas tshe lha rig pa 'dzin// drang srong lha klu mi sogs kyi// tshe bsod dpal grags 'byung ba lnga'i// dwangs bcud 'od zer rnam par bsdus// rang thim rtag pa'i rdo rje can// gzhom bral mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub// oṃ a mi dhe wa ā yuḥsid+dhi hūm̐/ ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ sbyin pa'i stobs kyis sogs phar phyin drug gi bden tshig dang*/ yang sgrib sbyong sogs la/ bde smon shes bya ma'am/ ngo mtshar sangs rgyas gang 'os bya zhing*/ snod bcud lhar bsdu de nyid kyang*// 'od zhu hrīḥr thim mi dmigs pa// ma bcos spros bral ngang du bzhag /slar yang lha skur lam gyis gsal// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag / sogs dang*/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// sogs dang bkra shis rim pa ci rigs brjod par bya'o// zhes pa 'di si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos chos khrims pa karma lhas skyabs kyi bzhed ltar 'dus sde'i zhal 'don rgyur spel ba dge bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ dkon mchog gsum la byang chub bar// skyabs su mchi zhing 'gro ba rnams// bde ldan sdug bsngal dang bral zhing*// bla med go 'phang thob gyur cig /dngos kun chos rnams stong pa'i ngang*// de las rang nyid pad zla'i steng*// hrīḥdamar 'od kyis 'phags pa mchod// sems can don byas yongs gyur las// bcom ldan snang mtha' tshe dpag med// dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i mdog

/zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi/ phyag rgyas lhung bzed bcud bkang nang*// tshe bum rin chen shing los brgyan// bsnams shing chos gos rnam gsum bklubs// zhabs gnyis rdor dkyil mtshan dpe 'bar// zla ba'i rgyab yol 'od lnga yi// zer dang zer thag kun tu 'phro// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan// thugs ka'i dbus su pad zlar hrīḥ /de las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi// chos dbyings rnam par dag pa'i zhing*// bde ldan pad+mo bkod pa nas// 'od snang mtha' yas tshe dpag med// bsgom pa dang 'dra'i ye shes pa// phyogs bcu'i rgyal dang rgyal sras tshogs// btsun mo byang sems nyan rang gi// 'khor tshogs spyan drangs mdun mkhar bzhugs// rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis// bskul ba'i mchod lhas mnyes par byas// dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥdam tshig dang*// ye shes gnyis med slar yang ni// thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros// dbang lha rigs lnga yab yum rnams// spyan drangs mchod pas dgyes pa bskyed// dbang bskur gsol gdab mod nyid la// dgongs pa mdzad cing lha yi chu// dri med dag pas khrus gsol zhing*// sku gang chu zhabs spyi bor brtan// tshe dpag med pas dbu rgyan gyur// rang 'od las sprul mchod lha mo// du ma spros pas kun bzang gi// smon lam ji bzhin mchod pa'i sprin// mkha' dbyings bkang bas mchod par gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shab+da bar gyis mchod la/ bde chen bde ba'i rang bzhin gyi// lhun grub zhing gi ston pa mchog /rgyal ba rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas gter// 'od snang dpag med phyag 'tshal bstod// thugs ka'i pad zlar hrīḥdamar po// de mthar sngags phreng g.yas su bskor// 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs mchod// tshur 'dus byin rlabs thugs rje'i stobs// lha sku'i rnam par spyan drangs nas// mtsho la char babs bzhin du thim// mchog thun dngos grub thob par bsam// slar yang 'od 'phros ma gyur 'gro// rigs drug 'khor ba'i skye sgo bcad// kun kyang lha yi dkyil 'khor dmigs// khyer so gsum ldan ting 'dzin dang*// oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ

snying po ci nus su bzlas la/ nye snying*/ hrīḥ ces pa'ang bzlas la/ mthar/ phyi snod lha yi dkyil 'khor pa// rang la thim zhing rang nyid kyang*// thugs ka'i sa bon la thim nas// de'ang mi dmigs 'od gsal ba// ma bcos spros bral ngang la bzhag / ces ci gnas rang babs su mnyam bzhag gi ngo bo bskyangs la/ slar yang lha skur gsal ba yi// gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan par gyur// snod bcud lha yi rang bzhin sku// sgra grags sngags la dran rtog thugs// kun bzang klong yangs chen por gsal// dge ba 'di yis sogs brjod/ skabs su gtor ma 'bul bar spro na/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las rin chen snod mchog tu// lha yi zhal zas gtsang zhing bzang*// 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa'i tshogs// rgya chen rgyun mi chad par mos// rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis// bskul las ye shes spyan drangs gyur// oṃ a kā ro sa lan gsum byin brlabs la 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ gong bzhin bstod pa dang*/ 'dod don gsol ba ni/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs nas/ kun 'grub mdzod bar brjod/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis bzod gsol dang*/ badz+ra mū sa ye shes gshegs pa'am/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa brtan bzhugs bya ba'ang legs/ ces pa'ang 'jang yul gyi sgrub pa karma thugs rjes bskul ltar si tu pas spel ba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ zhing sgrub dang tshe sgrub nyung bsdus dngos grub chu 'dzin bi ha ra tisma/ mchog gsum rgyal la skyabs mchi zhing*// 'gro don byang chub sems bskyed do// rang sems hrīḥyig yongs gyur las// spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog dkar// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin// g.yon pas pad dkar zhabs skyil krung*// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can// gnas gsum 'bru gsum mtshan par gyur// mdun mkhar pad zla'i steng du hrīḥ /yongs gyur bde chen pad+mo bkod// zhing mgon sangs rgyas 'od dpag med// dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis// mnyam bzhag lhung bzed sprul pa'i sku// mtshan dpe gzi 'bar chas rdzogs gsal// sku gsum ngo bo 'bru gsum mtshan// slar yang 'od 'phros rnam dag zhing*// rgya mtshor mnga' ba'i bcom ldan 'das// lha tshogs 'khor bcas thugs rgyud bskul// spyan drangs bdag mdun la thim gyur// oṃ a mi dhe wa dz+nyā na sarba ā be sha ya hūm̐/

dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis med gyur// bdag mdun thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las// mchod pa'i tshogs spros dgyes bskyed gyur// dbang lhas dbang bskur sku khrus gsol// chu lhag yar brten rigs lnga yis// rgyas gdab thugs kar zla steng hrīḥ /de mthar sngags bskor phreng ba las// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro sgrib sbyangs// bdag rgyud ye shes smin grol gyur// de nas lha yi rigs sngags bzlas la/ slar yang mdun bskyed thugs las 'od// lnga ldan phyogs bcur 'phros pa las// tshe nyams yal ba chad pa sogs// thams cad thig le 'od zer dang*// nṛ yig rnam par bsdus nas su// rang thim tshe dbang dpal 'byor pa// rab rgyas 'chi med mchog thob gyur// skabs 'dir/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a mi dhe wa ā yuḥsid+dhi hūm̐ hrīḥ ci nus bzlas mthar/ mdun bskyed 'od zhu dgyes mdangs bcas// rang gi spyi bor thim nas su// dbyer med gcig 'dres ma bcos pa// rang rig rang gsal chos dbyings kyi// rtsal gdangs klong yangs chen po'i ngang*// 'khor 'das dkyil 'khoXr gcig tu shar// dar cig lta ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag /mthar dge bsngo sogs spyi 'gro ltar bya'o// zhes pa'ang zhe 'dzong bla sprul karma a mā ra'i bzhed ngor spel ba dza ga taṃ/ bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan drug shog /dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// / ༈ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha dgu'i bdag bskyed rgyun khyer nges lam snying po'i don ston bzhugs so// na mo lo ki shwa ra ye/ 'dir dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug gi bdag bskyed rgyun khyer 'dod pas mchod pa dngos bshams sam/ yid sprul dmigs pas khyab par byas la/ dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ bdag dang ma gyur mkha' khyab 'gro ba rnams// phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i dpal// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha la skyabs su mchi// 'khor ba duḥkha'i mun par byings pa rnams// deng 'dir bdag gi sems bskyed 'od snang gis// mya ngan 'das pa'i lam la 'jug pa yi// yang dag ye shes phyir mi ldog phyir bsngo// sems can thams cad bde ldan sdug bsngal bral// bde dang mi 'bral mnyam nyid ngang gnas shog

/ de nas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ chos rnams thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur// de yi ngang las rang sems yi ge hrīḥ// dmar gsal ye shes lnga ldan 'od lnga'i zer// 'og gi phyogs 'phros 'od zer las grub pa'i// zhing khams rgya khyon chos dbyings tshad mnyam dbus// sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar byang chub shing*// lo 'bras nor bu rin chen bkra shis brgyan// de steng pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum/ lte bar bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi// sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi ldan ka brgyad sogs// mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor chen por gsal// phyi rol dur khrod brgyad dang mtha' skor du// rdo rje ra gur me ri 'bar pa'o// dkyil 'khor dbus su sna tshogs pad 'dab brgyad// lte bar nyi dkyil steng du hrīḥyig 'od// 'phros pas rgyal mchod 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sbyangs// kun kyang thugs rje chen por snang bar byas// 'od zer tshur 'dus rang thim yongs gyur las// bcom ldan spyan ras gzigs dbang sku mdog dmar// zhal gcig phyag bzhi rtsa phyag thal sbyar gyis// yum 'khyud g.yas 'og rdo rje rtse lnga dang*// g.yon 'og pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad 'dzin// dbu skra thor tshugs dar gyi cod pan dang*// rin chen rtse bran lngas brgyan zhabs rdor skyil// pang du yum mchog rdo rje phag mo dmar// zhal gnyis spyi gtsug phag zhal pheṃ sgra ngur// rtsa zhal khro gnyer spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs*// phyag gnyis g.yas pa rdo rje gri gug 'phyar// g.yon thod khrag bkang yab la stob bzhin 'khyud// skra grol thod skam lngas brgyan thod rlon gyi// do shal rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing*// zhabs gnyis thabs kyi sku la 'khril tshul gyis// skyil mo krung bcas bzhugs pa gsal bar gyur// phyogs bzhir pad nyi'i steng du hrīḥyig bzhi// 'od 'phros don gnyis byas nas hrīḥl thim// yongs gyur shar du mi bskyod spyan ras gzigs// dmar gsal spyan ma sngon mo gnyis med sbyor// lho ru rin chen spyan ras gzigs dmar po// mā ki ser mo mnyam sbyor nub tu ni// snang mtha' spyan ras gzigs dmar gos dkar mo// dkar dmar mdangs can mnyam sbyor byang don grub// spyan ras gzigs dmar dam tshig sgrol ljang sbyor// kun kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi yab rnams kyi// rtsa phyag yum 'khyud thal sbyar g.yas 'og mas// mu tig phreng 'dzin g.yon 'og pad+ma bsnams// zhabs gnyis skyil krung yum rnams phyag dang po// thal sbyar yab 'khyud g.yas 'og rim bzhin du// 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma ut+pal 'dzin// g.yon 'og rnams kyis pad+ma dmar po bsnams// zhabs gnyis bdag por 'khril tshul skyil krung bzhugs// dbu skra thor tshugs cod pan rtse bran sogs// rin chen dar dang rus pa'i rgyan rnams rdzogs// mtshams bzhir ha ri ni sa yongs gyur las// rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs// ḍā ki sngo ser dmar ljang sku mdog can// phyag g.yas rdo rje nor bu bum pa dang*// ral gri 'phyar zhing g.yon rnams pad+ma 'dzin// rus rgyan rin chen dar gyis mdzes pa'o// phyi rol 'dod snam lha mo gzugs sgra dri// ro dang reg bya so so'i brda chos 'bul// lha tshogs kun gyi spyi bor zla la oṃ// mgrin par nyi steng āḥdamar thugs ka ru// pad+mar hūm̐ sngon dang ni hrīḥdamar gsal// yab yum thugs srog hrīḥl sngags phreng ba// g.yas dang g.yon bskor mkha' 'gro bzhi'i thugs kar// rang mdog ha ri ni sa gsal bar gyur// rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros// bskyed pa dang 'dra'i ye shes dkyil 'khor gyi// rten dang brten par bcas pa sangs rgyas dang*// byang sems sras dang btsun mo'i tshogs bskor ba// mdun mkhar spyan drangs badz+ra mā dzaḥ

zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas spyan drangs la mchod pa ni/ oṃ/ nyer spyod bdun dang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// zag med bde chen mchod 'bul byin gyis rlobs// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ dhū pe/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ mdun mkhar ye shes dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams// rgyud bskul thugs las mkha' 'gro ma tshogs spros// mtshams bsrung shis brjod bum pas dbang bskur gyur// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ chu zhabs yar lud gtso bor snang mtha' yas// yum la rnam snang 'khor rnams mi bskyod pa// rin 'byung 'od dpag don grub rgyas gdab gyur// bdag nyid thugs kar pad+ma la gnas ba'i// hrīḥdang yum gyi thugs kar chos 'byung dbus// hrīḥlas 'od zer dkar ser dmar ljang 'phros// 'phags mchod kun kyang thugs rje chen po'i sku// char babs rang thim slar yang hrīḥyig 'od// zhal nas thon cing rigs bzhi yab yum dang*// mkha' 'gro bzhi yi thugs kar thim so so'i// thugs las 'od 'phros zhal brgyud bdag yab yum// thugs ka'i hrīḥr thim las bzhi 'grub par gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes yi ge bcu pa ci nus bzlas/ dhu ma gha ye na ma swā hā/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yongs kyi snying po ci rigs su bzla'o// de nas thun mthar rdzogs rim ni/ slar yang rang gi thugs las 'od zer 'phros// 'khor 'das lhar gsal la thim de dag kyang*// 'od zhu srung ba'i gur thim rang la bsdu// rang yang thugs ka'i hrīḥyig la thim pas// hrīḥyang 'od zhu gong bu nā da las// mi dmigs 'od gsal spros bral ngang du bzhag / ces ci gnas su bzhag / slar yang rang nyid zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// spyan ras gzigs gsal phyi snod gzhal yas khang*// nang bcud lha dang sgra grags sngags kyi gdangs// dran rtog ting 'dzin ngang la ngo bo skyong*// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten mgon// tshad med thugs rje'i rab bgrod kyis// deng 'dir 'gro drug sems can rnams// kun kyang mngon sangs rgyas gyur cig

/ ces dang*/ bsngo ba smon lam ci bder bya'o// zhes pa'ang rgyal rong khro chu shu bhaṃ chos grwa'i sgrub chen bla ma badz+ra lak+ṣa'i g.yar ngor/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bkod pa dge bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/// / ༈ rdo rje rnam 'byor ma'i bdag bskyed rgyun khyer mkha' spyod 'dzum zhal bzhugs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong las khams gsum chos 'byung gzhal yas dbus// pad+ma ro nyi'i steng du rang sems hrīḥ /dmar po'i 'od kyis don gnyis byas yongs gyur// bdag nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo// zhal gcig khro gnyer spyan gsum dmar la zlum// dbu skra kham nag 'bar 'phyang thod skam brgyan// mche gtsigs tshems kyis ma mchu mnan phyag gnyis// gri gug thod khrag gru mor kha ṭ+wām̐ brten// thod rlon do shal me tog dril g.yer dang*// phyag rgya lngas brgyan g.yon brkyang gar gyis rol// stong gsum khyab cing gzi 'bar gnas gsum du// 'bru gsum mtshan las 'od 'phros o rgyan nas// ye shes spyan drangs dbang bskur rgyas gdab gyur// gsang bar chos 'byung pad 'dab bzhir ha ri// ni sa dbus su hrīḥmathar sngags phreng g.yon// 'khor bas mchog thun dngos grub thob par gyur// oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ci nus mthar/ snod bcud 'od zhu bdag thim de yang hrīḥ /thig le nā da mi dmigs 'od gsal ngang*// slar yang bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku ru gsal// snang grags lha yi dkyil 'khor nyid du shar// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje phag mo sogs nas dge bsngo bya/ de ltar bu rgyal gyis bskul ltar spel ba dge// / ༈ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs las ram̐ yam̐ kham̐// tshogs rdzas la thim gnyis 'dzin dri ma sbyangs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes bdud rtsir spel// 'dod yon zag med bde chen mchod sprin gyur// ces pas byin brlabs la/

hūm̐/ dkon mchog kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung gnas mchog /rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs// dam tshig rdzas mchog pañtsa a mṛ ta// ga ṇa tsakra'i mchod pa chen po 'bul// thugs dam bskang ngo nongs bshags bar chad bgegs// dbyings su dag cing mchog thun dngos grub stsol// ces tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul nas lhag gtor bsngo ba ni/ bka' yi lhag gtor dbang rnams 'dir byon la// tshogs lhag bshal chu'i dam bskang phrin las mdzod// ces pa'ang tshogs mchod khyer bder ānan+da shā sa na'i bzhed ltar/ si tu pad+ma de wen+d+ra'i li khi taṃ/ sarba thā maṅga kurban+tu/// / ༈ rgyal yum 'chi med mchog ster 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgom bzlas ni/ skyabs yul dkon mchog rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing*// 'gro ba'i duḥkha sgrol phyir sems bskyed do// oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs la/ stong pa'i rang mdangs ma 'gags snang ba'i rtsal// rang byung rig pa'i ngo bo tām̐ yig dkar// de las 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro don byas// tshur 'dus yongs gyur 'chi med mchog sbyin yum// ston mtshan dbang po nya rgyas lta bu'i mdog /brgyad gnyis lang tshos sgeg pa zhi 'dzum ldan// zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu dang phyag zhabs mthil// ye shes spyan bdun bkra zhing dkar 'dzin zung*// rab rgyas mthon mthing lcang lo ltag par 'phyang*// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pas ut+pa la// lo 'dab ge sar bzhad pa thugs kar bsnams// mu tig gtsor gyur rin chen sna tshogs kyi// dbu rgyan dar dpyangs snyan cha mgul chu dang*// do shal se mo do dang phyag zhabs gdub// ska rags g.yer kha'i phreng bas mngon par mdzes// lha rdzas dkar pos stod g.yogs sna tshogs dar// smad dkris dang bcas zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung*// pad zla'i gdan bzhugs tsan+d+ra'i rgyab yol gsal// gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs kar tām̐ yig mtshan// de las 'od 'phros po ṭa la zhing nas// ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs dbyer med thim// dbang lhas dbang bskur snang mthas rgyas gdab gyur// oṃ ār+ya tā re badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/

sogs nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ snying gar pad zla'i steng du 'khor lo dkar// rtsibs brgyad mu khyud dang bcas lte bar tām̐// g.yas su oṃ dang spel tshig sngags mthar hā// rtsibs rnams so sor yig 'bru brgyad de las// 'od 'phros rgyal ba'i byin rlabs brtan g.yo'i bcud// bsdus nas 'khor lo yig 'brur thim par gyur//

yi ge bcu pa ci nus bzla zhing*/ sngags spel tshig can yang bzla'o// thun mthar/ snang srid ye shes lha yi dkyil 'khor pa// bdag nyid la thim rang lhar gsal ba yang*// yas mar 'dus nas thugs ka'i tām̐ la thim// de yang 'od zhu thig le nā dar bsdu// sems nyid ma bcos spros dang bral ba'i dbyings// dmigs med bde gsal mi rtog ngang du bzhag / ces mnyam par bzhag la rjes thob ni/ slar yang snang stong zung 'jug lha skur ldang*// 'jig rten dbang sras 'phags ma'i go 'phang la// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i srid 'gro ji snyed pa// 'god phyir 'khor gsum dmigs mtha' bral bar bsngo// ces pa'ang si tu pas rgyal ba'i phrin las dbon gang de'i bzhed ltar bkod pa shu bha puṣ+ṭiṃ/// / ༈ snang srid gnyis bsdus chos rnams kun// stong par gyur pa de'i ngang las// bam̐ las yan lag brgyad ldan mtshor// pam̐ las pad dkar 'dab stong ldan// a las zla dkyil steng du ni// rang sems tām̐ las 'od 'phros pas// don gnyis byas te 'phags ma'i sku// chu shel ston zla'i kha dog can// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin// g.yon pa'i mtheb srin ut+pal bsnams// spyan bdun bkra zhing lha rdzas kyi// dar dkar stod g.yogs sna tshogs dar// smad g.yogs dbu rgyan snyan rgyan dang*// mgul rgyan phyag zhabs gdu bu sogs// rin chen rgyan kun rab mdzes pa// zhabs gnyis rdor skyil zla ba yi// rgyab yol 'od dang 'od zer 'phro// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ yig dang*// thugs ka'i cha smad tām̐ yig mtshan// 'od 'phros po ṭa la zhing nas// rang 'dra'i lha mo dpag med pa// spyan drangs dam ye gnyis med bstim// rang gi thugs las 'od 'phros pas// dbang lhas dbang bskur mchod pas mchod// rigs bdag 'od dpag dbu rgyan gyur// thugs kar zla steng 'khor lo dkar// rtsibs brgyad mu khyud dang bcas pa// dbus su tām̐ mthar sngags phreng dang*// rtsibs brgyad yig brgyad 'greng thabs 'khod// 'od kyis rgyal mchod sems can kun// sgrib sbyang brtan g.yo snod bcud kyi// dpal 'byor bsdus nas yig 'brur thim// tshe dbang ye shes dbang thob gyur/

/yi ge bcu pa ci nus bzlas la/ phyi nang snod bcud dngos po rnams// 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor yongs shar ba// kun kyang rang thim 'od zhu nas// tām̐ yig nā da 'od gsal ba// dmigs med spros bral bde ba che// gang shar chos sku'i ngang du bzhag /slar yang rje btsun 'phags ma'i sku// yongs gyur gnas gsum yig gsum mtshan// gzung 'dzin dngos kun chos rnams kun// lha sngags ye shes rol par shar// dge ba 'di yis sogs/ ces gnas mdo kyu ra dge slong karma ye shes ngor spel/// / ༈ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi la hrīḥlas sgrol ma dmar mo/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon lcags kyus mtshan pa'i ut+pal 'dzin pa/ lha dang mi las 'das pa'i rgyan du mas spras pa/ zhabs rol pa'i stabs kyis mi yi dbang po mnan par bsam la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas mthar/ smon lam ni/ bcom ldan sgrol ma dbang mdzad dpal mo la// deng bzung snying po'i bar du skyabs gsol 'debs// rgyal pos 'jigs sogs bar chad nad gdon zhi// tshe bsod 'byor rgyas byang chub che thob shog / ces si tu pad+ma'i ming gis dad gsum ldan pa rmad dga' la spel ba/ ma gzhi a rā ga'i gsungs pa gzhir bzhag /smon gsol spel ba dge'o/// / ༈ swasti/ mchog gsum rgyal la gus 'dud 'gro ba rnams// 'byung ba zhugs lce'i 'jigs las skyob pa'i phyir// tā ra kro dhi'i bskyed bzlas zab gnad don// 'jug bde 'dir bkod bka' yi gnang ba stsol// swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ chos rnams dmigs med stong pa'i rang mdangs las// sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// rang nyid skad cig 'phags ma sgrol ma mchog /rab khros pad+ma rā ga'i ri bo ltar// dwangs shing gsal la 'od 'tsher zhal bdun ldan// mche gtsigs ljags bskyod ral g.yengs smin ma 'bar// phyag gnyis nor bu chu shel bdud rtsi can// 'od dkar bsil ba'i rang bzhin dkyil 'khor bsnams// dar dang rin chen rus pa'i rgyan dang ni// stag gi sham gsol zhabs gnyis rol stabs kyi// 'od dang 'od zer sna tshogs klong du gsal// gnas gsum 'bru gsum thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od kyis// bskul bas ye shes spyan drangs dbyer med gyur// thugs kar zla steng yig bcu'i sngags phreng las// 'od 'phros rang gzhan bskal pa nas bsags pa'i// sdig sgrib nyes tshogs 'phral gyi mi mthun phyogs// 'jigs brgyad bcu drug zhi zhing ag+ne ye// bar chad las rgyal snod bcud dag pa'i zhing*// po ṭa la yi gnas mchog mngon gyur nas// snang grag rtog tshogs lha yi dkyil 'khor shar// gzungs sngags rang sgras snang srid zhi ba dang*// byams pa'i ngang las dge legs skyed par gyur// oṃ shri khī ba da ne ma hā ulka mu khi dz+wa la ma li nā sap+ta dzi hwī/

sap+ta mu khī bi shwa na ri tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ ci nus bzla zhing lha yi nga rgyal brtan pos dmigs pa'i gsal 'debs gang 'os bya'o// mthar ni lha sku mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang*// ma bcos spros pa bral ba'i klong du bzhag /dge bas bdag gzhan sngon bsags 'phral las dbang*// rkyen ngan grol zhing bsam don chos bzhin 'grub// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba rnam par grol ba'i lam// bkod pa'i phrin las gegs med nyid 'grub shog / ces pa'ang rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs kyi sras mchog tshe dbang dpal dar mchog sprul gyi bka'i bzhed ltar/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bkod de phul pa maṅga laṃ/// /
